name: Survey tile in Cancer
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.4 degrees south of the ecliptic in Cancer, imaged by SPHEREx 13 times in 4 visits over 68 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 26 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.9 days starting 2026-04-13, at wavelengths from 0.83 to 4.40 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
